_note: Hand-written listings for brands with little or no usable Open Beauty Facts photography (Bella Vita, Beardo, Minimalist, Plum, Parachute). No photos: these render the SVG packshot (shape/colorPrimary/colorSecondary) until the brand supplies packshots. Prices are estimates of Indian retail. status PENDING = a seller submission waiting in the admin approvals queue.

products.name: Honey Oud Eau de Parfum
products.description: A warm, unisex eau de parfum that pairs golden honey with smoky oud and a soft vanilla base. Rich enough for evenings yet smooth enough to wear every day.
bullets: Top notes of saffron and honey
Unisex scent in a 100 ml bottle
products.howToUse: Spray from 15 cm onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and behind the ears. Avoid rubbing so the notes unfold naturally.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Benzyl Benzoate, Coumarin, Linalool.

products.name: Fresh Eau de Parfum for Men
products.description: A crisp citrus-aquatic perfume for men with bergamot up top and a clean cedarwood finish. Light enough for the office and the gym bag alike.
products.howToUse: Spray on the neck, chest and wrists after a shower. Reapply once in the afternoon if you like a stronger trail.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Limonene, Linalool, Citral.

products.name: Glam Woman Eau de Parfum
products.description: A bright floral-fruity eau de parfum built around pink pepper, jasmine and a creamy musk base. Made for evenings out and special occasions.
bullets: Pink pepper and pear top notes
products.howToUse: Mist onto pulse points and the hair ends from about 15 cm away. Layer over an unscented body lotion for a longer trail.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Benzyl Salicylate, Hydroxycitronellal, Linalool.

products.name: Skai Aquatic Eau de Parfum
products.description: A breezy unisex eau de parfum with sea-salt accords, mint and a soft woody base. A cool, clean scent for hot Indian summers.
products.howToUse: Spray on the wrists and neck in the morning. Keep the bottle away from direct sunlight to preserve the scent.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Limonene, Linalool, Geraniol.

products.name: Luxury Perfume Gift Set for Women, 4 x 20 ml
products.description: Four 20 ml eau de parfums in one box, from soft florals to warm gourmands. A ready-made gift that lets her find a signature scent.
bullets: Florals, fruity and warm gourmand scents
products.howToUse: Spray on pulse points. Try one scent per day to discover a favourite.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Linalool, Limonene.

products.name: Godfather Perfume for Men
products.description: A bold, woody-spicy eau de parfum for men with black pepper, leather and patchouli. A confident evening scent that lingers.
bullets: Black pepper and cardamom top notes
products.howToUse: Spray two to three times on the neck and chest. Do not rub; let it settle on the skin.
products.ingredients: Alcohol Denat., Parfum (Fragrance), Aqua, Coumarin, Linalool, Limonene.

products.name: Activated Charcoal Face Wash for Men
products.description: A deep-cleansing gel face wash with activated charcoal that draws out dirt and excess oil. Leaves men's skin fresh and matte without feeling tight.
bullets: Activated charcoal for a deep cleanse
products.howToUse: Wet your face, massage a small amount for 30 seconds and rinse. Use twice a day.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Charcoal Powder, Menthol, Tea Tree Oil, Fragrance.

products.name: Salicylic Acid 2% Face Serum
products.description: A lightweight 2% salicylic acid serum that exfoliates inside the pores to keep them clear. Suited to oily and combination skin that gets congested easily.
products.howToUse: Apply 2 to 3 drops on clean, dry skin in the evening. Start every other night and always use sunscreen the next morning.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Propanediol, Salicylic Acid, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Ethoxydiglycol, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Phenoxyethanol.

products.name: Alpha Arbutin 2% Face Serum
products.description: A water-light serum with 2% alpha arbutin and hyaluronic acid that targets the look of uneven tone and dark spots. Gentle enough for daily use, morning or night.
bullets: Helps even out the look of skin tone
products.howToUse: Apply 3 to 4 drops on clean skin, morning and night. Follow with moisturiser and sunscreen in the day.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Alpha-Arbutin, Propanediol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol.

products.name: Green Tea Oil-Free Moisturiser
products.description: A light gel-cream moisturiser with green tea and glycolic acid that hydrates without adding shine. Made for oily and acne-prone skin that still needs moisture.
products.howToUse: Smooth a pea-sized amount over clean face and neck, morning and night.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Glycolic Acid, Niacinamide, Carbomer, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol.

products.name: Advansed Onion Hair Oil
products.description: A coconut-based hair oil enriched with onion and curry leaf for regular scalp massage. Non-sticky and easy to wash out.
products.howToUse: Massage into the scalp and lengths an hour before washing, or leave on overnight. Use two to three times a week.
products.ingredients: Cocos Nucifera Oil, Allium Cepa Bulb Extract, Murraya Koenigii Leaf Extract, Tocopherol, Fragrance.

products.name: Advansed Jasmine Coconut Hair Oil
products.description: A light coconut hair oil with the fragrance of fresh jasmine for everyday nourishment. Leaves hair soft and lightly scented.
products.howToUse: Apply a few drops to the scalp and hair daily, or massage in generously before a hair wash.
products.ingredients: Cocos Nucifera Oil, Paraffinum Liquidum, Fragrance, Tocopheryl Acetate.

products.name: Dandelion Visibly Ageless Serum
products.description: An ayurvedic face serum with dandelion, Indian ginseng and wild turmeric in a light, non-oily base. Leaves skin feeling smooth and refreshed.
products.howToUse: Smooth a few drops over clean face and neck at night, massaging in upward strokes.
products.ingredients: Taraxacum Officinale Extract, Withania Somnifera Extract, Curcuma Aromatica Extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Preservatives.
